message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Per board: open board → three dots (⋮) → Board → Download board backup, which drops an `.rtb` file on your disk (1 GB limit per board, one board per run); Boards → Export as PDF/image/CSV gets you a visual copy. On Enterprise only, an eDiscovery Admin can bulk it: Admin console → Enterprise Guard → eDiscovery → Cases → Exports → Download boards, landing as one archive (auto-split above 50 GB) with up to 1,000 boards per job, downloadable for 14 days. [Miro + 4](https://help.miro.com/hc/en-us/articles/360017572774-How-to-save-board-backup)
- **We pull it**, Instructions: Profile avatar → Settings → Your apps → Create new app (in a Developer team) → tick the `boards:read` scope → Install app → copy the access token, then send it to us over secure means. If you're on Enterprise, instead log in as Company Admin and grab the Discovery access token from the Enterprise integrations admin console, that one reaches everything; send that over secure means.

Please let me know if you would prefer we pull the data or you push it!
notes: Board backups are capped at 1 GB per board and eDiscovery exports at 1,000 boards per job.
Both routes are partial: exports and the API each omit some board data.
